keyword.en: why a blank concrete pump specification stays blank
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵参数空格为什么不能抄

title.en: Why a Blank Pump Cell Cannot Be Copied
title.zh: 混凝土泵的空白参数格为什么不能抄

description.en: A missing pipe, pressure, aggregate or voltage cell on one Xingtai page is not filled from the next model.
description.zh: 某一页邢台参数缺少管径、压力、骨料或电压时，不能用下一型号来填。

h1.en: Why a Blank Pump Cell Cannot Be Copied
h1.zh: 混凝土泵的空白参数格为什么不能抄

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery expects each concrete pump page in Xingtai to be read alone. Electric 15 has no pressure cell, so Electric 20's 10 MPa is not its pressure. Diesel 40's specification table has no aggregate row. Electric 10 has no vertical distance. LZ-80's height says consult factory standard, which is not LZ-60's 300 m. Copying a neighbour's cell invents a figure the catalogue does not print.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械要求邢台的每一台混凝土泵页面单独阅读。电动15没有压力格，所以电动20的 10 MPa 不是它的压力。柴油40的规格表没有骨料行。电动10没有垂直距离。LZ-80 的高度写咨询工厂标准，那不是 LZ-60 的 300 m。抄相邻格子，等于编一个目录没有印的数字。

body.en: Electric 15 prints no outlet pressure. B500S-83D prints no theoretical output in m³/h. Diesel 50 prints no aggregate size. Electric 60 prints no pipe diameter. HBT8018 prints no hopper volume. Each of those absences is specific. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule that the nearest model supplies the missing number.
body.zh: 电动15不印出口压力。B500S-83D 不印以 m³/h 表示的理论输送量。柴油50不印骨料粒径。电动60不印管径。HBT8018 不印料斗容积。每一处缺失都是具体的。河北品锦机械没有公布“用最接近的型号补数字”的规则。

body.en: A shared commercial number such as 30, 40 or 80 does not authorise a copy. Electric 30 and Diesel 30 are different power lines. Electric 80 and LZ-80 are different output notations. Keep the slug in the address, /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ or /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/.
body.zh: 商品名里相同的 30、40 或 80 并不能授权抄写。电动30和柴油30的动力行不同。电动80和 LZ-80 的产量写法不同。请把网址里的型号留住，例如 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/ 或 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Quote only cells that are on the page you opened. For a missing cell, write that it is not printed and use /en/contact/. The factory is Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai.
body.zh: 只引用你打开的那一页上的格子。缺的格子就写明没有印出，并使用 /zh/contact/。工厂是位于邢台任泽工业园区的河北品锦机械。

question.en: Can I use Electric 20's pipe on Diesel 30?
question.zh: 可以把电动20的管径用在柴油30上吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 does not print a pipe diameter. Electric 20's 80 mm stays on Electric 20.
answer.zh: 不能。柴油30没有印管径。电动20的 80 mm 留在电动20。

question.en: Is consult factory standard equal to 300 m?
question.zh: 咨询工厂标准等于 300 m 吗？

answer.en: No. 300 m is LZ-60's delivery height. LZ-80 does not print that number.
answer.zh: 不等于。300 m 是 LZ-60 的输送高度。LZ-80 没有印这个数字。

question.en: Does a shared model string merge two pages?
question.zh: 相同的型号字符串能合并两个页面吗？

answer.en: No. Read the page slug. Shared text does not fill cells that differ or cells that one page lacks.
answer.zh: 不能。请读页面地址。相同的文字不能填补不同的格子，也不能填补某一页缺少的格子。

answer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery, through the contact page. The sheet itself does not supply it.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械，通过联系页。参数页本身没有提供。
